written: before any arm is fitted; score_00_verify.py had already passed at this point and no arm had been constructed
scoped_experiment: the regression stage: predict Target (iloc[:,11], the effective bit-flip rate) from the released 145-row table; the only learned component of Q-Cluster and the only place the arms' inputs differ
resample_unit: one row of the released 145-row table, i.e. one (circuit, machine) pair
resample_scheme: nonparametric bootstrap, rows drawn with replacement, 145 rows per draw; models are fitted and selected once on the actual data and held fixed, so the interval is conditional on the fitted and selected models exactly as the plan requires
interval: two-sided 95 percent percentile interval, the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the bootstrap distribution of S

estimand.metric: mean squared error of the out-of-fold prediction, the released cell-6 criterion
estimand.note_on_metric: S is invariant to using MSE or R2, because within a single bootstrap draw all three arms share the same target variance and the two forms of S differ by a factor that cancels; this is stated as a fact, not a choice
estimand.T: A - F, the full arm's improvement over the affine control
estimand.K: A - C, the descriptor control's share of that improvement
estimand.D: C - F, what the execution-derived inputs add beyond descriptors
estimand.formation: T, K, D and S are all formed INSIDE each bootstrap draw from that draw's resampled rows; no separately averaged number is divided by another

arms.recipe_held_fixed: KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=40), the released cell-6 and cell-7 split; out-of-fold predictions for every one of the 145 rows; identical folds for every arm
arms.A: affine control: LinearRegression (ordinary least squares) on that ladder's descriptor set
arms.C: capacity-matched descriptor control: the released 7-regressor bake-off (RandomForest, GradientBoosting, ExtraTrees, DecisionTree, SVR, KNN, XGBoost, with the released hyperparameters), scored by mean 5-fold MSE, winner taken; run over the SAME descriptor set as A
arms.F: the released feature set (Qubit, Measure, rz, sx, x, ecr, entropy, esp_m), refitted under the same bake-off and the same selection rule; F is identical under both calibration ladders because the ladder moves only what A and C may read
arms.released_predictions: none exist per row; the notebook builds res_d in memory and discards it, so F is the refit and the released-versus-refit comparison is made on the cell-6 stored aggregates

calibration_ladder.with_calibration: A and C read Qubit, Measure, rz, sx, x, ecr, esp_m
calibration_ladder.without_calibration: A and C read Qubit, Measure, rz, sx, x, ecr
calibration_ladder.why_esp_m_is_dropped_whole: esp_m is a circuit-times-calibration product computed by get_esp_modified_therm over the transpiled DAG; it has no pure-circuit part to keep
calibration_ladder.selection: neither variant is selected; both are reported, and if they land on opposite sides of the reading rule the system is reported as split on calibration access

reading_rule.above_0.5: failure mode PRESENT in this system
reading_rule.below_0.5: failure mode ABSENT in this system
reading_rule.applied_to: the primary S interval of each calibration variant, under random_state=40

saturation_diagnostic.definition: the strongest descriptor-only predictor the released data supports, no capacity match, no measurement input; share of target variance explained on held-out rows
saturation_diagnostic.search: a candidate set larger than the released bake-off with a small hyperparameter grid, scored by out-of-fold R2 under the same folds
saturation_diagnostic.reported: both the optimistically-selected maximum (an upper bound, which is the conservative direction for a bound) and a nested-CV value that pays for the selection
saturation_diagnostic.ladders: reported for the descriptors-only set and for the descriptors-plus-calibration set, since those are the two sets a descriptor control may read

secondary_and_sensitivity.random_state_42: the same scoring repeated under the cell-9 fold seed, reported beside the primary, not substituted for it
secondary_and_sensitivity.MAE_variant: S recomputed on mean absolute error, reported as a labeled sensitivity only; the reading rule is applied to the primary MSE form
secondary_and_sensitivity.downstream_6_rows: Hellinger fidelity of QCluster(prob=p_hat) on the 6 master_dict rows, run without the fit_x comparator and without the ip-Entropy filter; a corroborating check only, explicitly not scoreable and carrying no interval

instability_rule_declared_now: the fraction of bootstrap draws with T <= 0 is reported beside the interval; the percentile interval on S remains the primary reported quantity whatever that fraction is, and separate intervals for T, K and D are reported alongside so a small or sign-changing denominator is visible rather than hidden

leak_checks_at_this_point.2_oracle_read_by_an_arm: PASS, re-run independently; no arm reads ip Entropy, the ideal support size, or the ideal distribution, and the ip-Entropy case filter is not applied
leak_checks_at_this_point.3_row_counts_and_schema: PASS, asserted against the released bytes by sha256 before anything else
leak_checks_at_this_point.4_row_shuffled_split: RECORDED AND REPORTED, not a refusal; 29 of 29 algorithms straddle folds under both released seeds, 94.2 percent of target variance is between circuits and 1.5 percent between machines, so a descriptor arm that merely fingerprints the circuit recovers most of the target; this favours the descriptor arms and therefore favours finding the failure mode, and any PRESENT reading carries the qualification in the same sentence

forbidden_here: dropping this system after seeing its result
averaging or pooling S with any other system
reading a zero-crossing interval as absence
reconciling a released-versus-refit gap by adjusting the recipe after seeing it
